message: core-js has install scripts and npm 10.5.1 to 10.9.9 (with Node.js 22 in .nvmrc) run them, because npm before 11.16.0 does not read the denial in allowScripts in package.json; depcurfew.json denies them
fix: Use npm 11.16.0 or later wherever the project installs, or make npm stop running dependency install scripts there (run depcurfew apply and follow its warnings)
